_about: GENERATED by .claude/atlas-build/build-fronts-plates.js (monthly part) and .claude/ww2-plates/fortnight.py (fortnightly part, run by hand) — never edit. Every plate of the Second World War front the Atlas draws: date, theatre, source, the uncertainty it carries and its four sets (axis, axis_occupied, allied, allied_occupied) as lon/lat rings, holes nested by depth. build-history.js reads it and checks the pinned source hashes. `stand`: the days a plate stands after its date, at most, before the next plate of its theatre replaces it (a gap draws nothing). January–June 1943 has no plate in either source.
